report_metadata.evaluation_readiness: Audit completed; research prototype validation only. Not for clinical use.
report_metadata.privacy_guarantee: No patient-level identifiers (names, MRNs, or raw subject IDs) are included in this aggregate audit report.

overlap_and_duplication_signals.audit_interpretation: Identical phenotype profiles do not prove identical patients. In published cohorts, shared profiles often represent family members, minimal recorded feature sets, or standard syndromic presentations.

grouping.evaluation_split_guidance: All cases from the same publication must remain together in any future evaluation split to prevent cross-split leakage.
